x.author: AnthonyOgogo
x.body:
Follow 👉🏽 @anthonyogogo 👈🏽
For fitness and mindset tips 💪

What worked for you at 20 might be exactly what’s holding you back after 30.

At 20, you could train 6 days a week, smash 90-minute workouts, eat almost anything and still make progress.

Recovery was faster.
Life was simpler.
And you had more time.

But after 30, the rules change.

Trying to train like you’re still 20 can leave you feeling burned out, sore, and frustrated with your results.

Instead:

🏋️ 3–4 quality sessions can beat 6
